newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA V PAKISTAN ASIA CUP MATCH ABANDONED.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA V PAKISTAN ASIA CUP MATCH ABANDONED.

text.p: The Asia Cup replay match between fierce rivals India and Pakistan was abandoned without a ball being bowled on Monday after heavy overnight rain affected Colombo's Singhalese Sports Club ground.
The match was called off after nine overs on Sunday due to rain and poor light and was scheduled to be replayed on Monday.
Cricket officials said the teams would share the points from the match.
India, who have a low net run rate, now need to beat Bangladesh by a big margin on Thursday to ensure a place in the final against Sri Lanka on Sunday.
